dedupeText: contemporary country album cover layout outdoor portrait geometric sans serif blue and tan palette upper third typography rocky background subject gaze directed away from camera creates a reflective mood contrast between the cool blue of the clothing text and the warm tan of the rocks horizontal alignment of text blocks balances the verticality of the subject combine a shallow depth of field outdoor portrait with a two tiered geometric sans serif header using color blocking to separate the primary and secondary text elements

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium portrait of a man in a light blue jacket leaning on a metal railing against a blurred rocky landscape, featuring a two-tiered typographic header in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed away from camera creates a reflective mood.
Contrast between the cool blue of the clothing/text and the warm tan of the rocks.
Horizontal alignment of text blocks balances the verticality of the subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, leaning on a diagonal railing.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hands serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text, move down to the secondary text bar, and settle on the subject's profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third is utilized for text, while the blurred background provides breathing room around the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones (tan, beige, grey) in the background rocks.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light blue in the subject's jacket and navy blue in the text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the secondary text and highlights on the railing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value in the jacket and text highlights.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Wide letter spacing (tracking) in the primary display text
Condensed tracking for the secondary text bar

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a horizontal navy bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying weights and tracking.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rectangular bar behind secondary text with subtle gradient or texture.

preserve: Wide tracking for the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean geometric structure and weight contrast needed.
Excellent open-source alternative with similar geometric proportions.
Classic geometric sans that matches the sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man with a beard and short brown hair, wearing a light blue zip-up jacket, leaning on a rustic metal railing. The background should be a blurred, out-of-focus rocky hillside in warm tan and grey tones. Leave the top third of the image clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary text in a large, light-weight navy blue geometric sans-serif font with wide tracking at the top. Below it, add a thin navy blue horizontal bar containing the secondary text in a bold, white geometric sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the top text uppercase and widely spaced?
Is the secondary text inside a dark horizontal bar?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to make the text legible?
Does the color of the jacket harmonize with the navy text?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the display text
Height of the secondary text bar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: The navy bar does not obscure the subject's head.
The lighting on the subject matches the outdoor environment.
The font weights are clearly distinct between the two lines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a shallow-depth-of-field outdoor portrait with a two-tiered geometric sans-serif header, using color-blocking to separate the primary and secondary text elements.
